people.imagined: The evening after the bell, in the cold upper hall. She has just put her cold hands round a bowl of snow-melt tea that she cannot feel, and is listening to a novice's footsteps in the corridor, smiling a little before she knows who it is.
people.subject: The moment: in a cold, bare upper hall at evening, a very old prioress holds a bowl of snow-melt tea in both hands and looks up with a warm smile, listening to a novice's footsteps before she knows who it is. Face, most important: a small, delicate, very old face, the skin thin and pale as rice paper with a faint blue tint, a thousand fine wrinkles around kind, bright, dark eyes, a soft mouth and a tiny straight nose; the smile is warm but the hands are visibly cold, with white fingertips and a faint frost on the knuckles. Hair: none, the head shaved and smooth beneath a white hood. Body: small and narrow, the spine perfectly straight, sitting very upright. Clothing: an undyed white wool-silk robe with a high crossed collar and wide sleeves, tied with a plain white sash; over her shoulders a sheer white veil-robe that shimmers with rime, its hood drawn up; a string of pale pear-wood beads at her left wrist. Hands and objects: a plain white porcelain bowl of steaming tea held in both hands, the steam freezing into a thin mist; at her elbow on a low table a small bronze bell the size of a pear, dull green with a pale bluish ice sheen. Background: a blurred white wall and the pale blue of a high window. Light: cool blue-white winter light from the upper left, with a faint warmth rising from the tea. A faint ice-blue Water hint lies in the frosted veil. Expression: a calm, warm smile that reaches the eyes, soft and unhurried, with a deep weariness settled under it.

people.imagined: At the gate at dawn, in front of the visitor who has come uninvited. She has laid her left hand on the hilt of a pear-wood sword and has not drawn it; she copies the vow each morning and believes every word of it.
people.subject: The moment: standing squarely in a gateway at dawn, she stares down at the viewer with one hand on a sword hilt, not drawing it. Face, most important: a face like a closed door: a long, flat, still face, high pale forehead, deep-set black eyes giving nothing, a long straight nose, thin lips pressed in an unmoving line, a vertical line between the brows; no expression, no age beyond a few fine lines. Hair: iron grey, drawn back tight into a plain low knot and pinned with a single wooden pin. Body: tall, straight and spare, shoulders squared in the doorway. Clothing: a long dove-grey wool robe, well fitted, with a high crossed collar and a dark-grey sash; over it an old, short brown miner's coat lined with grey cloth, the hem stitched with iron thread; a string of grey beads, one hundred and eight, wound around the left wrist. Hands and objects: her left hand grips the pale pear-wood hilt of a thin grey sword in a plain scabbard held at her hip; her right hand hangs open at her side, the inked tips of her fingers stained black. Background: the dark timber of a gate, and blurred snow and pale sky. Light: a cold white dawn from the upper left. Faint ice-blue and steel-grey hint. Expression: closed, absolute, unblinking.

people.imagined: Ringing the bell at night. She has just struck it and, with her eyes closed, hums its note back without knowing she is doing it, her fingers dusted with fine jade.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a bronze bell, striking it, she hums the note with eyes closed, mouth gently open. Face, most important: a round, soft, plump-cheeked face, pink with cold, an open humming mouth; fine green-white jade dust plainly lodged in the creases of the knuckles of both hands held before her; closed eyelids, thick dark lashes, a gentle small nose. Her brows are soft and short, her lashes thick, and a tiny white scar sits at the left corner of her mouth. Hair: none, the head shaved smooth under a white hood. Body: round-shouldered and sturdy, a little short. Clothing: an undyed white wool-silk robe, a high crossed collar, wide sleeves pushed back to the wrists, a white sash; a string of pale pear-wood beads on the left wrist. Hands and objects: a padded wooden striker in her right hand; before her a dull bronze bell hung from a beam, with pale blue-white ice crystals frozen on its lip; her knuckles dusted pale green. Background: a blurred dark timber beam and a night of snow and stars. Behind her a great timber beam carries the bell, with a coil of rope, a stack of firewood, and through an open arch a long slope of blue snow under a sky of hard stars. Light: cool silver starlight from the upper left, a dim warm lamp. Ice-blue Water hint. A thin line of rime on the bell edge flashes in the starlight. Expression: absorbed, humble and gentle.

people.imagined: At the gate in the afternoon glare, with a basket of larch mushrooms on the ground in front of her. She takes it, as she does every spring, and has just turned the man away.
people.subject: The moment: standing in the glare of the gate, she faces the viewer squarely with a woven basket of larch mushrooms at her feet, a hand on a short sword. Face, most important: a deeply sunburnt face, red-brown, peeling across the nose and cheekbones from the gate's glare, a broad strong jaw, squinting, a short flat nose, thin dark brows; wide, level, hard brown eyes. A band of pale untanned skin runs across her forehead where the headscarf sits, her lips are chapped and split, and her eyes are narrowed by glare into dark slits. Hair: black, in a thick low knot under a grey cloth headscarf. Body: broad in the shoulder, strong, squat; thick arms. She stands with her feet planted a shoulder-width apart and her chest forward, a soldier's stance, her weight even. Clothing: a dove-grey wool robe with a quilted jacket, the sleeves tied back; a dark sash; leather bracers, boots of oiled leather. Hands and objects: her right hand rests on the hilt of a short, broad, miner's grey sword; a round basket at her feet full of pale brown mushrooms. Background: blurred wooden gate timbers and white snow glare. Behind her the gate has two huge dark posts with a crossbar capped with snow, an iron lamp unlit, a worn stone threshold, and a bright white slope with a line of small footprints leading away. Light: hard white sun from the upper left. Steel-grey Metal hint. The sun glares off the snow and bounces under her jaw, flattening the colours around her to near white. Expression: loyal, stern and impatient.

people.imagined: On the glacier terrace among cracks of snow lotus, kneeling over a basket of salves for the miners. She crushes a petal between her fingers and smells it, then turns to the viewer, smiling.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling among snow lotus on a glacier terrace, a healer with a crushed white petal between her fingers turns and smiles at the viewer. Face, most important: a warm, wide, lined, comfortable face rosy with cold, with deep laugh-lines, a wide kind mouth and a snub nose; the sleeves of her robe carry neat appliqué squares in many colours, green, rust, yellow and blue, one square sewn on for every salve she makes, plainly visible as she reaches. Hair: none, the head shaved beneath a white hood, with a few stubbly grey hairs showing at its edge above the ears. Body: stocky and sturdy, kneeling easily with her skirts bunched in the snow, one hand on the basket, the lines of her arms soft and strong. Clothing: an undyed white wool-silk robe, clean and well fitted, the colour-coded squares set along both sleeves in tidy rows; a white sash; a string of pale pear-wood beads. Hands and objects: at her side a basket of small clay pots with cloth lids; in her hand a white snow-lotus flower with one petal crushed. Background: a cleft of blue ice opens behind her with pale lotus flowers growing in the cracks at several heights; far off a lower terrace and a track of footprints leading down towards a small smoke-blue village. Light: bright cold white light from the upper left, a slanting silvery gleam picking out the veins of the petals and the ice crystals on her hood. A faint ice-blue Water and green Wood hint. Expression: a broad, easy, generous smile, relaxed brows and patient eyes, entirely at home.

people.imagined: At her desk in the book-room, she has dipped the brush and lifted her head from forty years of bending over it, eyes the washed blue of old ink, to see who has come.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a low desk with a brush lifted, she raises her head slowly from the page and meets the viewer's eyes. Face, most important: her neck bent forward in a permanent stoop, the head carried low and out in front of the shoulders like a heron; a long, thin, gentle face, deep lines at the mouth, a thin straight nose; pale washed-blue eyes, the colour of old ink, faded and kind; fine white eyebrows. Hair: none, the head shaved under a white hood. A few white eyelashes and very pale brows frame the washed blue eyes. Body: thin, bowed, narrow shoulders. Clothing: an undyed white wool-silk robe with plain high collar and sleeves tied back with cords, a white sash. The right sleeve is stained with a fine speckling of black ink at the cuff, and she wears a pair of felt slippers under the hem of the robe. Hands and objects: a long brush with a black tip held in the right hand; a thick book of many thin pages open on the desk; an ink-stone. Background: a blurred wall of shelves with many bound volumes. Behind her tall wooden shelves hold rows of thick bound books with plain cloth covers, a shuttered window with a strip of grey daylight, and a tiny brazier with a thin plume of smoke. Light: a pale grey light from a window on the upper left. Faint ice-blue hint. A little warm lamp glow edges the desk and the brush, and the grey window light falls cold over her bowed neck. Expression: forgiving, calm, diligent.

people.imagined: In the glacier's blue corridor, a black pebble in her sleeve. She is drawing lots for a berth and has just raised her left hand, the two lost fingertips showing, to show the pebble she drew.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a corridor of blue glacial ice, she raises her left hand to show the viewer a small black pebble held between finger and thumb. Face, most important: the left hand held up shows two blunt, shortened fingertips, the ends missing and scarred smooth and white from frostbite; a long, composed, pale face, high cheekbones, heavy lids, a calm, arbitrary mouth, unmoving dark eyes. A thin film of frost whitens her brows and the fine hair at her temples, her lips are pale and slightly blue, and a fine white scar crosses her chin. Hair: none, the head shaved smooth under a white hood. Body: tall, slender, unhurried. Clothing: an undyed white wool-silk robe, quilted at the cuffs, a white sash, a string of pale pear-wood beads; a faint rime on the shoulders. Hands and objects: a black pebble between thumb and finger; a small lantern of cold lamp oil with a pale flame hung at her belt. Background: blurred glacier walls, pale blue, with a dark shape of a body wrapped in white lying facing away. On each side the walls of the glacier are a deep translucent blue lined with trapped bubbles, a row of small shallow niches cut at shoulder height, and a pale white-wrapped shape lying in the nearest one. Light: cold blue light from the upper left, a thin lamp flame. Faint ice-blue Water hint. The blue light from the walls is cold and bright, and the lamp at her belt makes one small yellow spot on the ice. Expression: devout, calm and unreadable.

people.imagined: The mine road at night. She knocks twice on a stone wall before leaning on it, as she has since the shaft fell, and the knock echoes. She glances at the viewer, one hand on a hidden hoard.
people.subject: The moment: on a mine road at night, she knocks twice with her knuckles on a rock wall before leaning her shoulder to it, then looks at the viewer. Face, most important: her left ear is notched, a deep scar-bitten gap taken from the rim, plainly visible with the hair pulled back off it, and a long pale shaft-fall scar runs from the ear to the jaw; a lean, tough, weathered face, a short nose, thin lips, hard dark eyes, a greedy glint. Hair: black with grey, tied in a tight knot under a grey headscarf. Body: wiry, hard, weight on one shoulder. Clothing: a dove-grey wool robe and a quilted jacket, a dark sash; leather bracers; a bundle of candle ends tied at her belt. Hands and objects: the knuckles of her right hand against rock; a short sword in a plain scabbard at her hip; a lantern with a stub of candle. Background: a blurred rocky mine road and wooden props. Timber props and a rusted tub on rails lean at the roadside, and a few small snow flurries drift through the lantern's glow. Light: a dim candle light from the upper left, blue-black night. Steel-grey and ochre hint. Expression: loyal, stubborn and sharp.

people.imagined: At the gate, a carter's boy at her elbow and two coppers pressed into his palm. She looks to the viewer with a very reasonable face and a cowlick that will not go flat.
people.subject: The moment: at a gate, she passes two coppers to a boy just out of frame and smiles brightly at the viewer. Face, most important: a stubborn cowlick sticks straight up from the crown of her head through the grey headscarf, a tuft of black hair standing like a feather, impossible to miss; a pretty, round, clever face, bright dark eyes, a quick wide smile, a small mole beside the nose. A scattering of small freckles crosses her nose, and her ears are pierced with tiny jade studs that she has covered with the scarf. Hair: black, in a bun under a grey scarf, the cowlick sticking up. Body: slender, quick, easy. She stands lightly with one hip cocked, a hand half-hidden at her back, easy and alert. Clothing: a dove-grey wool robe with a quilted jacket, neat and well cut; a dark sash; a thin green ribbon sewn at the cuff. Under the grey quilted jacket she wears a pale grey inner collar; the dark sash holds a small leather purse, and her boots are lined with white rabbit fur. Hands and objects: two small copper coins between her fingers; a sheathed sword at her hip. Background: blurred gate timbers and snow. Behind her the gate's wooden posts are streaked with frost, a plain cart-track marked by wheel ruts leads down through a stand of pale birch trees, and a boy's small dark shape waits by the post. Light: bright cold daylight from the upper left. Ice-blue and green hint. The sky is a clean pale blue and the snow throws up a bright cold glow under her chin. Expression: gregarious, ambitious and a little sly.

people.imagined: Setting out down the mine road with a letter bag over her shoulder, pulling her left sleeve back to show something to a friend, and then hiding it. She trusts the prioress and thinks opening the bag is the rule.
people.subject: The moment: shouldering a letter bag on a snowy mine road, a girl turns, smiles trustingly at the viewer and lifts her left sleeve cuff a little. Face, most important: just inside the cuff a clan-green silk ribbon the width of a finger is sewn, bright green against the grey wool, shown for a second; her face is round, open and fresh, with rosy cheeks, a short nose, big trusting hazel eyes and a gap-toothed smile, her nose and ears red with cold and a tiny new freckle at the corner of her left eye. Hair: light brown, in a long plait over her shoulder. Body: slender, young and brisk, walking with a spring in her step, shoulders back and arms swinging, a girl who thinks she is trusted. Clothing: a dove-grey wool robe under a quilted jacket buttoned to the neck with wooden toggles, a dark sash knotted in a small bow, a knitted wool scarf of uneven loops, and boots edged with a band of bright felt. Hands and objects: a leather letter bag with a flap on a strap over her shoulder; a short sword at her hip. Background: the mine road winds down a white slope between rocks and pines behind her, with a thin curl of smoke from a village far below and a bell-shaped hut at a bend. Light: bright winter light from the upper left, pale gold sun lighting one side of her face, her breath a visible white puff. A faint green Wood and ice-blue hint. Expression: an eager, open, friendly smile and bold bright eyes, certain that everyone she meets is on her side.

people.imagined: Climbing at dusk above the gate when she should be coughing in her bunk. She has stopped and looked down at her hands with a laugh that arrives late; green grit under every nail.
people.subject: The moment: pausing on a snow slope above the gate, she laughs a beat late and shows the viewer her hands. Face, most important: the nails of both raised hands are lined with jade-green grit, a dark pale-green crescent under every nail, plainly visible; a sharp, bright, ambitious face, narrow chin, a long nose, quick eyes, a wide smile that arrives half a second late. She has a streak of grey rock dust along one cheekbone, a small split in her lower lip, and a narrow pale scar through her left eyebrow. Hair: black, in a bun under a grey headscarf; a cough-cloth tucked in her sleeve. Body: lean, sinewy, mid-climb. She leans into the slope on one hand, the other raised, a lean climber's body with knees bent and weight on her toes. Clothing: a dove-grey wool robe, hem wet from snow, a quilted jacket; leather bracers; boots caked with snow. A cough-cloth of pale cotton hangs from the sleeve, the knees of her trousers are dark with melted snow, and a coil of thin rope is slung across her chest; she wears small pointed iron cleats on her boots. Hands and objects: both hands open before her; a short sword at her back. Background: blurred snow slope and a dim pink sky. Above her the slope narrows to a jagged ridge where a thin cloud catches pink, and below her the gate and a tiny dark roof show among the snow. Light: low pink dusk light from the upper left. Steel-grey and ochre hint. The light is a deepening rose and violet, with a cold blue shadow filling the hollow behind her. Expression: ambitious, impatient and sly.

people.imagined: Late at night copying names. She has licked the brush again, and her lip is black; the new white robe is still stiff and creases like paper. She looks up and begins to write the miners' names she was told not to.
people.subject: The moment: seated writing, she looks up from a page with a brush at her lips. Face, most important: her lips and the tip of her tongue stained black with ink, plainly dark, a black smear at the corner of the mouth and chin; a gentle round pale face, a small nose, wide, earnest eyes; a shaved head, the scalp pale blue-white. Her fingertips are blackened to the second joint with ink, and her cheeks are pinkish from the lamp's warmth; a small bead of ink has dropped on her left cheek. Hair: none, shaved, bare, with a white hood fallen back. Body: slight, sitting upright. Clothing: a brand-new white wool-silk robe, so stiff that the folds stand out sharply like paper; a white sash; a string of pale beads. Hands and objects: a fine brush held in the right hand with ink on the fingers; a long scroll of names unrolled on the desk. Beside the scroll stands a small lacquer box holding fine brushes and a cake of ink in a saucer. Background: a blurred lamp-lit wall. Behind her low shelves stacked with scrolls tied in white cord, a second desk with a bowl of ink-stones, and a paper screen showing the shadow of snowflakes against the window. Light: warm lamp from the upper left. Faint ice-blue Water hint. The lamp casts a soft pool of amber on the desk, and cool blue light from the paper screen touches her shaved scalp. Expression: compassionate, humble, diligent.

people.imagined: At the grindstone at dawn, a long sword half finished, sparks flying. She will not let go of the wheel until the blade is done, and she snarls a smile with a chipped front tooth at whoever is watching.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a grindstone as sparks fly off a sword blade, she looks up and bares her teeth in a wrathful grin. Face, most important: a chipped front tooth, a clear triangular notch broken from one upper incisor, shown in a snarl; a strong, square, freckled face, thick brows pulled down, hard black eyes, a stub nose; fine white nicks and spark scars on both forearms, clearly visible, rolled up. A thin line of ash-grey dust lies in the creases of her forehead, her nostrils flare, and the chip in her tooth shows a small dark gap. Hair: black, cropped short under a grey headscarf. Body: stocky, strong-armed, braced. Clothing: a dove-grey wool tunic with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a leather apron burnt with spark holes; trousers; boots. Hands and objects: a long plain steel sword blade pressed to a stone wheel, orange sparks showering; one foot on the pedal. At her feet lies a bucket of dark water with a short sword half submerged, steam rising from it. Background: blurred wall and a pale dawn window. Behind her a rough stone workshop with swords hung on a rack in order of length, buckets of quenching water, a stack of grey whetstones, and a high narrow window letting in a cold bar of dawn. Light: orange spark glow from below and cold dawn from the upper left. Steel-grey Metal hint. The shower of orange sparks lights her chin and the lower half of her face, while the window light puts a blue edge on the top of her head. Expression: wrathful, callous and absorbed.

people.imagined: In the miners' hut with a crushed hand in hers, glass phials rattling in the satchel at her hip, her ears red with chilblains. She has said aloud she would rather stay below.
people.subject: The moment: sitting at a miner's bench in a hut, a young healer holds an injured hand in a clean cloth and looks up with an earnest frown. Face, most important: both ears are bright red and swollen with chilblains, glowing against the white hood and twice their natural size; her face is young, open and round, with wind-chapped pink cheeks, fine frost lines in her brows, a broad nose, honest brown eyes and a mouth set to say something unwelcome. Hair: none, the head shaved under a white hood pushed back. Body: sturdy, kneeling on one knee on a straw mat and leaning over the hand, her broad back curved with care. Clothing: an undyed white wool-silk robe with the sleeves tied back, a white sash, a canvas apron with a smear of salve; a pear-wood bead string. Hands and objects: a roll of bandage in one hand; at her hip a leather satchel packed with small glass phials, each stoppered with wax. Background: a low miner's hut with a rough timber ceiling, a lamp on a hook, a bench loaded with pots of salve, a bucket of water, and the pale outline of a miner with a bandaged hand sitting very still. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left meets the cold blue of the open doorway, the two tones meeting on her cheek. A faint ice-blue and green hint. Expression: a frank, steady, caring frown, the lips pressed as if about to say she would rather stay below, her eyes warm all the same.

people.imagined: In the loft, hiding with a tune; a broom abandoned downstairs. She holds her breath so the song will not leave and her throat bobs.
people.subject: The moment: in a loft with her cheeks puffed, a girl holds back a tune, her throat jumping, and smirks at the viewer. Face, most important: her throat bobs visibly, a plain lump at the neck above the collar, a swallowed note; her face is round, freckled and merry, with a snub nose, quick bright light-brown eyes, lips pressed tight and trembling at the corners, a wisp of straw stuck to her lip and a small gap between her front teeth. Hair: black and wild, in a messy loose braid with straw in it, no scarf. Body: lithe and loose, sitting cross-legged on a sack, her shoulders shaking slightly with the held-in song and her toes curling in the straw. Clothing: a dove-grey wool robe, rumpled from lying in the hay but fine and sound, open at the throat; the dark sash tied carelessly and half undone; a grey headscarf hangs round her neck rather than on her head; bare feet stick out below the hem. Hands and objects: a sheathed short sword abandoned behind her; the handle of a broom at the edge of the frame. Background: a dusty loft with beams, stacked sacks of dried herbs, an old broom leaning on a beam, and a small round window with a patch of blue sky and a small brown bird on the sill. Light: a slanting shaft of warm light from the skylight at the upper left makes the dust glitter around her. A faint ice-blue hint. Expression: a mischievous, bursting, barely contained grin, eyes sparkling and sliding toward the viewer.

people.imagined: On the east slope at dawn, squinting at the rising sun, golden pupils glinting; she is the first Light-rooted novice and no one knows what to teach her.
people.subject: The moment: standing at dawn on an east-facing slope, a girl squints at the rising sun, then fixes the viewer with a proud gaze. Face, most important: her pupils are bright gold, two clear amber-gold discs shining in the eyes, unmistakable, the gold spreading in thin rays into the iris; her face is fine-boned, pale and narrow, with a small arrogant chin, a high nose, pale lashes, a thin firm upper lip, cheeks slightly flushed and a squint creasing her brow. Hair: black, in a tight plait pinned up, no scarf. Body: slender and rigid, chin high, shoulders squared, the stance of a girl who has been told she is special and fears being told otherwise. Clothing: a dove-grey wool robe under a well-fitted quilted jacket, with a dark sash. Hands and objects: one hand lifted to shade her eyes; the other rests on a short plain sword at her hip. Background: a vast white slope falls away behind her, tinted pink and gold, and a low band of cloud lies across the valley with the sun just rising out of it. Light: low golden sunrise from the upper left, dazzling; the sun sits just behind her left shoulder, throwing a bright rim on her hair and a strong gold gleam into her eyes. A faint warm-gold Light hint. Expression: a proud, guarded stare, the mouth tight, a little defiant, wary under the pride.

people.imagined: In the book-room, kneeling to read the names of the dead azaleas of her village, murmuring. The white robe swamps her. She looks up shyly, flat plain face and a mole on her cheek.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling before a book, she murmurs a name and looks up shyly at the viewer. Face, most important: a flat, plain, homely round face with a dark mole like a dropped seed on one cheek, clearly visible, small close-set eyes, a wide nose, thin brows with a frost-white fleck; no beauty, only sincerity. Her eyebrows are fine, frosted, nearly white fleck in the dark, her cheeks are heavy and soft, and the mole on her left cheek is dark brown with a single short hair. Hair: none, shaved under a hood. Body: short, heavy, shoulders lost in the robe. She kneels on a thin cushion with her knees together, shoulders rounded as though trying to take up as little space as possible. Clothing: a white wool-silk robe a size too large, sleeves drooping over her hands, a white sash gathered in folds, a string of pale beads. Hands and objects: a thin white sleeve-end holding a page of the book; a single pink azalea petal tucked in the book. Background: a blurred dim room. Behind her a low desk with a lamp, shelves of bound books, a vase with one pale pink azalea branch, and a narrow window through which a slope of snow is visible under a dim sky. Light: a pale soft lamp from the upper left. Faint ice-blue hint. The soft lamp light is gold on her face and sleeves, leaving the corners of the room deep grey. Expression: devout, humble and shy.

people.imagined: On the gate step at dawn with the broom. She counts the men who come; she is counting the viewer.
people.subject: The moment: sweeping a gate step at dawn, a girl stops and leans on the broom, counting the viewer with her eyes. Face, most important: a long, steady, cold stare, the eyes narrowed and measuring and one brow lifted; a small, thin, sharp-chinned face, pale, with a narrow nose, tight lips, a faint horizontal crease between the brows from constant thinking, thin pale eyebrows and a small bead of cold at the tip of her nose; a faint smile of calculation. Hair: black, in two small buns under a grey scarf, a few loose hairs sticking up at the back. Body: thin and small, standing with her feet together, her back stiff and her weight on the heel of the broom. Clothing: a dove-grey wool tunic under a quilted jacket, a dark sash and a clean apron. Hands and objects: a broom handle polished to the shape of her palm, gripped in both hands; a small silver bell at her sash. Background: the huge dark timber posts of a gate, a snow-dusted stone step swept clean in a half-circle, and a long white road falling away down the hill with two tiny figures far off. Light: pale early-morning light from the upper left falls flat across the snow so that the dark gate is the only strong shape; a faint steel-grey hint. Expression: a cool, shrewd, unreadable look, the mouth closed, giving nothing away while weighing everything.

people.imagined: 702, the foot of the sealed mountain. She stands with the cut ice and the new-cast bell beside her, white hair loose, having sealed the empty cave. She has written the vow and is looking up at it.
people.subject: The moment: standing in snow before a sealed cave mouth, a bronze bell beside her, she looks up at the sky with grave calm. Face, most important: her hair is pure white, long and loose, blown back, snow-white from the night of the pear-blossom snow; a long, serene, noble face, high brow, quiet pale lips, fine lines, deep dark eyes that look far away, a stillness in her. A fine web of lines edges her eyes, her pale lips are pressed in the shape of a vow she has just written, and a few white petals rest on her shoulders. Hair: white, long and loose to the waist, a single white pear blossom pinned over the ear. Body: tall, slender, straight. She stands perfectly still with her feet together, one shoulder slightly lower, and her hands hold the sword the way another woman would hold a child. Clothing: a long robe of undyed white silk with wide sleeves and a pale grey sash. Hands and objects: a plain sword with a dark hilt held upright in both hands before her, point down. Background: a blurred ice cave mouth sealed with stone, falling pear-blossom snow. The cave behind her is a dark mouth filled with a wall of neatly stacked stones, a small bronze bell the size of a drum sits in the snow beside it with a skin of ice, and white petals drift through the air. Light: soft white light from the upper left. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: loyal, patient and compassionate.

people.imagined: 771, the Gate Hermitage's step, the snow falling. She has found a child sitting in the snow, and is bending to speak in her slow voice, one eyelid never quite closed.
people.subject: The moment: bending over, in falling snow, to speak slowly to someone small just out of frame, her gaze kind and level. Face, most important: one eyelid, the left, never fully closes, a half-open slit showing the white of the eye, clearly visible; a broad, calm, slow-moving face, wide cheeks, a broad nose, a gentle wide mouth. Deep lines run from her nose to the corners of her mouth, her lashes are short, and snowflakes have settled on her brows. Hair: none, the head shaved under a plain white hood. Body: large, broad, gentle, stooped forward. She bends at the waist with one hand on her knee, a large woman moving carefully, her weight on her heels. Clothing: an undyed white wool robe with wide sleeves, a white sash, a string of pear-wood beads. A dark grey woollen shawl is folded over her shoulders under the white robe and the beads are wound three times round her wrist. Hands and objects: her right hand held out open, palm up, with snowflakes falling on it. Background: blurred snowfall and a timber gate. Behind her the timber gate posts loom out of the falling snow, a small lantern hangs unlit from a hook, and the child's shape is only a smudge of grey at the edge of the frame. Light: soft grey light from the upper left. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: forgiving, calm, slow.
